subject: Intro: SolvaData (self-signup) — partner referral for product demo
messages:
From: Leila Haddad <leila.haddad@artemis-works.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <skhan@solvadata.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Intro: SolvaData — interested after self-signup (short context + contact)

Hi Ben — looping you in on a partner-sourced inbound. Samira at SolvaData completed a self-serve signup yesterday and asked for a short product walkthrough focused on inference cost controls and dedicated capacity options. She mentioned they’re evaluating for an MVP starting in Q4 and want to understand latency guarantees and SSO/SCIM requirements.

Samira (cc) — Ben is our SDR covering mid-market SI referrals; he’ll get a short demo on the books and pull in a solutions engineer for the deep dive.

Quick context on the customer: SolvaData is an analytics SaaS (50 engineers), primary cloud in us-west, will likely want private deployment later. Priority: short discovery + demo this week if possible.

Attaching a one-line lead sheet. Let me know if you want me to intro on the call.

Attachment: solvadata-lead-sheet.csv (attachment stub)

Thanks —
Leila Haddad
Partnerships, Artemis Integrations
leila.haddad@artemis-works.com
+1 415-555-0148
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <skhan@solvadata.com>
Cc: Leila Haddad <leila.haddad@artemis-works.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: SolvaData — interested after self-signup (short context + contact)

Hi Samira — great to meet you, and thanks Leila for the intro.

Welcome to Redwood — I saw your signup and would love to get a short 30–40 minute demo scheduled to cover:
- Quick product overview tailored to SolvaData
- Dedicated vs hosted tradeoffs for cost/latency
- SSO/SCIM and data residency considerations (we’ll bring an SE)

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue Jul 13, 10:30–11:10am
- Tue Jul 13, 2:00–2:40pm
- Wed Jul 14, 9:00–9:40am

If none of those work, please send a couple of options or pick a slot on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/ben-carter/30min

I’ll include Soojin (solutions) for the technical deep dive and Marissa (partner lead) so she’s aware of the pipeline.

Agenda draft attached.

Attachment: demo-agenda-v1.pdf (attachment stub)

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 512-555-0199
Redwood Inference

Hi Ben — thanks for the quick note. I’m excited to connect. The 2:00pm slot on Tue Jul 13 is almost perfect but I have a standup that runs long sometimes — could we instead do Tue Jul 13 at 3:00pm or Wed Jul 14 at 9:00am PST? Ideally we’d have an SE on the call to go over SSO, token handling, and any on-prem options.

Also — could you confirm if you support short-term dedicated capacity for an initial pilot? Budget is modest; we’re focused on predictable cost per inference while we validate the product.

Best,
Samira Khan
Head of Platform, SolvaData
skhan@solvadata.com | +1 206-555-0123

Soojin will join for SSO/SCIM and to answer tokenization and KV cache questions. We’ll aim for a 25–30 minute walkthrough with an additional 10 minutes for technical Q&A.

Meeting invite (Google Calendar) will follow. Quick agenda attached and a short SSO checklist if the SE wants to triage beforehand. If you have any docs you want us to review before the call, drop them in the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-demo-assets
